status: MINED_EVIDENCE_CORPUS — regression-case design ONLY. Business policy was NOT modified.
core_distinction_requested: LOCAL_ACTION_ALLOWED != GLOBAL_WEEK_OBJECTIVE. A local risk gate passing (e.g. VOCAL failure_rate=0) proves the action's local risk is permitted; it never proves the planner should select that action for the week.
primary_review_target: WINGRUN_20260905_01 (S4 planning failure: TE target 500000 missed at 419414)

cases.title: S4 route deadline model omitted complete remaining-route-step budget
cases.local_evidence_that_was_true: VOCAL failure_rate reads fresh and 0% in S4W1/W2; stamina full; weeks 8 > min_required_wins(4) + margin(1)
cases.global_week_objective_violated: TE gap 388850 with max eligible reward 100000 required 4 wins + failure margin within 8 weeks; the +1 margin budgeted ONE failure but not the complete remaining route steps per remaining week
cases.observed_outcome: 3 preparation VOCAL weeks; route started at weeks=5 boundary leaving 5 THE LEGEND attempts; results PASS/FAIL/PASS/PASS/FAIL = 3 wins < 4; TE FAILED
cases.required_regression: policy must compare fresh remaining_weeks against complete remaining_required_route_steps (including retry budget for expected failures); route deadline computed from fresh season+week-bound evidence only

cases.title: No execution-boundary invariant rejected low-priority training at/after route latest safe start
cases.local_evidence_that_was_true: third S4 VOCAL had failure_rate 0% and adequate stamina — locally allowed
cases.global_week_objective_violated: weeks-6 VOCAL consumed the last additional attempt budget (postmortem-safe route start was fresh S4 weeks=6; the number 6 is run-specific, not a global constant)
cases.observed_outcome: first irreversible preventable decision; only five attempts remained, two failed
cases.required_regression: at/after the declared route deadline boundary, the next route action must replace low-priority training; goal execution independently rejects a forged low-priority action conflicting with an attached deadline; unknown boundary → NEED_MORE_OBSERVATION, never inferred from one run

cases.title: Trace week-label contamination (weeks=1 record error)
cases.local_evidence_that_was_true: STOP trace entry written during battle freeze
cases.global_week_objective_violated: week-state reporting integrity: unsupported weeks_remaining=1 claim contaminated reconciliation
cases.observed_outcome: s4_reconciliation forced weeks=5 with explicit conflict_cause note; artifact later marked SUPERSEDED_BY_FINAL_RUN_EVIDENCE
cases.required_regression: week labels require provenance-matching fresh boundary; a record that conflicts with observed boundary must be quarantined, not reconciled-by-override; trace schema must separate pre-action week from post-action week

cases.title: Untaught business choice resolved by operator (いいよ)
cases.global_week_objective_violated: none at stop-time — but the operator-supplied いいよ was logged with choice_audit=RUN_LOCAL 待审计 and produced a persistent 約束 (promise) flag influencing later weeks
cases.observed_outcome: promise badge appeared S1W7, deferred S1W8; planner had no model of promise consequences
cases.required_regression: operator-resolved choices must enter a taught-choice review pipeline before any future autonomous reuse; PROMISE_TRUE_BUSINESS_CHOICE subtype requires handler ownership distinct from fast-forward

cases.title: Endgame futility not surfaced (0906 S3 weeks 4→1 VOCAL with unreachable gap)
cases.local_evidence_that_was_true: VOCAL trouble 0% every week; gap decreased ~1000-1200/week
cases.global_week_objective_violated: target gap 31744→28336 with 1 week remaining was mathematically unreachable via VOCAL; planner continued VOCAL without flagging futility
cases.observed_outcome: honest final record: TARGET NOT MET (22672/50000), rank D; scenario concluded normally
cases.required_regression: when projected maximum gain over remaining weeks < remaining gap, planner must emit ENDGAME_FUTILE notification and seek operator decision; silent continuation is a reporting regression even when each local action is risk-permitted

cases.required_regression: fresh-season HOME boundary must evaluate prep prerequisites before weekly loop; prep-late detection

cases.title: Local risk gate semantics: failure_rate=0 proves permission, not optimality
cases.local_evidence_that_was_true: VOCAL_FAILURE_RATE_GATE: value 0 <= 2 → VOCAL_ALLOWED executed correctly (first live execution S3W6 27% correctly blocked → REST)
cases.global_week_objective_violated: the gate is a necessary-condition check only; using 'gate passed' as the reason for choosing VOCAL in a route-critical week is the exact LOCAL_ACTION_ALLOWED != GLOBAL_WEEK_OBJECTIVE confusion
cases.observed_outcome: S4 preparation weeks 1-3 all cited fresh 0% reads as decision support while the route deadline was being consumed
cases.required_regression: decision trace must record which rule CONSUMED the week (business objective) separately from which gates PERMITTED it (risk); a week whose permit-evidence is only a risk gate must be flagged PLANNER_JUSTIFICATION_WEAK

cases.title: Detector HOLD treated as validated (business_choice detector)
cases.local_evidence_that_was_true: discriminating evidence for 3-card advice vs 2-card business choice accumulated (+1 REPEATED_EVIDENCE)
cases.global_week_objective_violated: dual_check_choice_encountered=false in the validation run — absence of 2-card instances is NOT detector validation; detector status correctly stayed HOLD
cases.observed_outcome: no failure, but a planner consuming 'detector validated' from this run would violate honesty rules
cases.required_regression: detector promotion requires a positive 2-card instance under the new policy, not clean weeks; status HOLD must block business-choice automation

cases.title: S4 fan totals occluded by Congratulation banner (estimate drift)
cases.global_week_objective_violated: planning inputs used estimates (~112000+, ~113000+ 推定) instead of fresh exact fans; exact gap planning degraded
cases.observed_outcome: planner switched to week-count-based planning (correct fallback), but the estimates were recorded in trace as planning observations
cases.required_regression: occluded planning field → planner must record UNREADABLE and use a defined fallback, never interpolate estimates into gap math; schedule page offers a fresh fan read when HOME banner occludes

cases.title: Planner candidate rules with confidence 0.0 must not be promoted by adjacent successes
cases.local_evidence_that_was_true: season_2_required_audition / season_3_audition / season_4_audition candidates existed with confidence 0.0 and blocked_by unknowns
cases.global_week_objective_violated: any promotion path that lets adjacent VOCAL successes raise blocked candidate confidence would convert unverified strategy into executable policy
cases.observed_outcome: candidates remained CANDIDATE_ONLY; S4 behavior ultimately came from operator prompt authority, not from candidate rules
cases.required_regression: promotion of planner candidates requires the evidence class the unknown registry demands (e.g. planner_season4_large_auditions); success counts from other rules must not leak

cases.title: S3 repeated VOCAL with fresh failure_rate=0 finished 22,672/50,000 and S4 was never reached (quiet futility variant)
cases.run: WINGRUN_20260906_01 (S3 weeks 4→1, plus S1/S2 recovered weeks)
cases.local_evidence_that_was_true: every remaining S3 week read fresh トラブル率 0% (risk_gate_allows(VOCAL) true on every decision); VOCAL executed cleanly each week (trouble 0%); all local postconditions verified (weeks-1, fresh HOME)
cases.global_week_objective_violated: planner_selects(VOCAL) repeated while the 50,000-fan target required ~+31744 fans over 4 weeks; realized VOCAL gain ~1000-1200/week made the target mathematically unreachable from the S3W4 boundary onward; no route/fan-target check ever overrode the default VOCAL selection; S4 (and any rescue route) was never reached
cases.observed_outcome: S3 finished 22,672/50,000 (rank D, gap 27,328); scenario concluded normally with おふたりは立派 ending; honest TARGET NOT MET recorded
cases.required_regression: risk_gate_allows(VOCAL) must NOT imply planner_selects(VOCAL). Planner objective selection must separately satisfy route/fan-target logic: (a) projected maximum gain over remaining weeks vs remaining gap (futility check), (b) route prerequisites/flags before default selection, (c) explicit ENDGAME_FUTILE operator escalation when unreachable. A week whose selection justification is only a risk gate is PLANNER_JUSTIFICATION_WEAK (PLR-007 trace separation applies).
cases.relation_to_0905_variant: WINGRUN_20260905_01 (PLR-001/002) is the deadline variant: route consumed by preparation. WINGRUN_20260906_01 (PLR-011) is the quiet-futility variant: no deadline pressure, gate simply passed every week while the objective was unreachable. Two independent runs, one root distinction: LOCAL_ACTION_ALLOWED != GLOBAL_WEEK_OBJECTIVE.

summary.key_principle: VOCAL failure_rate=0 (local, replicated, risk-permitting) appears as true local evidence in PLR-001/002/005/007 — each time the global week objective required route/audition/escalation logic the local gate cannot supply. PLR-011 (added 2026-09-06 reconciliation) is the strongest negative example: fresh failure_rate=0 every week yet S3 ended 22,672/50,000 with S4 never reached.
